risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and strongly quantified, highlighting substantial revenue, profitability, operating-ratio, volume, pricing, and cost trends. Risk tone is confident and favorable, but the business remains exposed to economic demand, fuel-price volatility, labor productivity, capacity conditions, and debt-covenant performance. Management relies on moderately hedged forward-looking language when discussing future costs, demand, liquidity, and covenant compliance.
